tei:div.tei:p: "$ (593)༄༅// dpal myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i gtor chog rgyas pa'i kha skong dmigs rim dang bcas pa gsal bar bkod pa las bzhi lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(594)༄༅// na mo gu ru dzñā na nā thā ya/ spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul ni// bdud 'dul nag po chen po'i skur ston pa// bla ma mgon po dbyer med der btud nas// gtor chog rgyas pa'i kha skong khrigs su dgod// rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā thas mdzad pa'i mgon po'i sgrub thabs gtor chog dang bcas phrin las gter mdzod ces bya ba dgung grangs nyer bdun par mdzad pa 'di ni nyams su len bya thams cad tshang zhing gsal la rgyas pas mgon po 'di'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la med du mi rung ba'i yig cha yin la/ de las bsdus pa da lta'i sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi sdebs su bzhugs pa 'dir ni grib sel gnad dbab rgyas par 'dzud par ma gnang bas de dag gi bka' thob cing bsnyen sgrub byed pa sogs la cung zad mi bde bar mngon zhing gtor chog tsam la khyer bde bar mthong*/ yang de dag tshang zhing tshig tshogs shin tu bsdus pa dgung lo nyer gsum par mdzad pa zhigs kyang 'dug la/ gangs dkar sku gnyer nyi ma rnam rgyal la gnang ba'i ches bsdus pa 'di dag ni rgyun gyi rnal 'byor lta bur spros pa mi lcogs pa rnams la nye bar mkho ba yin no/ 'di dag thams cad la rang bka' spyi dang khyad par snying zhugs bla mgon dbyer med kyi byin rlabs dang khrid nos shing bsnyen sgrub nyams len sngon du song ba dag gis bdag mdun gnyis ka mgon po gtso 'khor du bskyed chog la/ bka' thub thun mong ba tsam las ma thob cing bsten sgrub sngon du ma song ba dag gis ni bdag nyid yi dam dang*/ mdun du mgon po (595) 'khor bcas bskyed pa nyid legs pa yin/ bdag bskyed yi dam gang rung du bsgom par gsungs pa ltar bka' gdams gsar ma bdag gis bdag bskyed rta mgrin gsang bsgrub la mdzad pas mtshon mtha' gcig tu nges pa ma yin kyang*/ rang re rnams kyi rgyun gyi lag len tu rgyud sde lnga gtso bsdus kyi lus dkyil rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa 'dis byed dgos pa yin/

gtor sgrub skabs lta bur rje btsun nyid kyis mdzad pa'i skyer sgong rta mgrin kyi las byang dregs pa kun 'dul nyid btang na 'brel chags shing ches legs par 'byung ba'ang 'phros su smos pa'o// 'dir phrin las rgyas pa nyid gzhir bzhag rgyun tu de las cung zad bsdu bar 'os pa dang*/ gtor sgrub gtor chen nyer dgu'i dus mchod/ gzhan yang 'bar ma lta bu'i skabs kha skong bar 'os pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdoms te 'bri bar bya ba la/ thog mar rgyun 'don lta bur mngon rtogs cung zad rgyas pas ma lcogs na 'di bya ste/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i/ rdo rje'i srung 'khor dur khrod chen po'i dbus/ paṃ las padma raṃ las nyi ma'i steng*/ gi las tshogs bdag dkar po glang chen dbu/ la phug ne'u le 'dzin pa nyal stabs gnas// de steng hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan// 'od 'phros dgra bgegs tshar bcad 'phags pa mchod/ sems can don byas slar 'dus yongs gyur las/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po mthing nag 'bar// (596)zhal gcig phyag drug spyan gsum dmar la zlum// zhal gdangs ljags 'dril 'jigs pa'i nga ro bzhad// smar smin dbu skra kham nag gyen tu brdzes// li khri'i thig le mi bskyod rgyal pos brgyan// dang po gnyis kyis gri gug thod khrag bsnams// bar pas thod phreng bgrang zhing rtse gsum gsor// 'og mas ḍā ru 'khrol zhing zhags pa 'phen// mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bgegs kyi rgyal po brdzis// thod skam dbu brgyan thod rlon do shal mdzad// stag lpags sham thabs dar dang rin po che// klu chen brgyad dang rus pa'i rgyan drug mdzes// phyag zhabs dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng ba 'khrol// sbom thung lto ba rgyas shing yan lag hrag /bzod dka'i gzi ldan bskal me 'bar ba'i klong*// tsandan sdong por sku rgyab bsten pa'o// g.yon du khrag zhags 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho'i klong*// bhyo las lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug nag

/drag shul nyams ldan sprul pa'i mtshon lnga 'chang*// dbu skra gyen brdzes rma bya'i mdongs kyis brgyan// lte bar nyi ma spyi gtsug zla ba 'char// snyan cha g.yas g.yon dug sbrul seng ge 'phyo// glang chen ba lang ko bas stod smad g.yogs// re lde'i sham thabs gsol zhing gos nag gyon// rus pa'i rgyan dang mi mgo'i do shal 'phyang*// me rlung dbus bzhugs dre'u rta rkang gsum chibs// ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sdes bskor// mdun du kṣiṃ las kṣe tra pā la mthing*// gri thod 'dzin cing dom nag smyon pa chibs// gnod sbyin gdug pa can gyi tshogs kyis bskor// g.yas su hūm̐ las dzi na mi tra dmar// cang te'u 'khrol zhing sdigs mdzub me lce 'bar// gza' dang srin po 'jigs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor// rgyab tu ṭāṃ las ṭā kki rā dza nag// g.yas pas rgyu zhags g.yon pas sdigs mdzub sgreng*// 'khor du gsod byed gshin rje khros pas bskor// gsum ka rus pa'i rgyan dang stag sham gsol// g.yon du hūm̐ las bdud mgon trakshad nag /ru mtshon thod 'dzin rta nag rting dkar chibs// bdud kyi chas ldan lha dang bdud dmag (597)bskor// kun kyang khro gtum thod pa'i rgyan cha can// me rlung drag tu 'tshubs pa'i dbus na rol// de yi phyi rol phyogs skyong chen po bcu// rang rang rigs mthun 'bum gyis yongs su bskor// gzhan yang lha brgyad klu brgyad gza' chen brgyad// 'jigs byed dgu dang rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad// rgyal chen bzhi rnams rang 'khor bye ba bcas// de yi phyi rol dam can sde brgyad dmag /gnod sbyin srin po sha za gshin rje bdud// ma mo'i cha lugs khro gtum mtshon cha thogs// gnam sa bar snang kun gang thams cad kyang*// sgrub po'i re ba tshul bzhin skong ba'o// kun gyi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan// hūm̐ las 'od 'phros shar lho bsil ba'i tshal// tsandan sdong po'i drung nas nag po che// steng na bla ma g.yas na dpa' bo dang*// g.yon na dpa' mo mdun na bka' sdod bcas// skad cig nyid la ḍā ru g.yer kha'i sgra// sil sil khrol khrol 'ur 'ur byon par gyur/

/zhes pa ni mngon rtogs 'dzin brjod bde bar bsdus pa ste// phrin las rgyas pa 'di btang phyin skabs rer mngon rtogs kyi tshig tshogs bsdus pa 'di tsam byed na ma gtor gzhan bsdur yod pa ma yin no// spyan 'dren gyi thog mar grub chen khyung pos mdzad pa 'di nyid bya ste/ /hūm̐/ bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs// chos dbyings rnam dag ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur bstan pa// lha chen ma hā kā la spyan 'dren no// nag po chen po gshegs su gsol// legs ldan nag po gshegs su gsol// rnal 'byor dgra lha gshegs su gsol// rig 'dzin srung ma gshegs su gsol// zhing skyong nag po gshegs su gsol// 'khor gyi dmag tshogs gshegs su gsol// 'khor gyi bka' nyan gnod sbyin tshogs// kṣe tra pā la gshegs su gsol// dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol// ma hā kā la mthu bo che// sku mdog mthing nag chen po la// dbu skra khams ser ral pa can// ral pa'i thor (598)cog gyen du bsgrengs// ral pa'i gseb nas me stags 'phro// me stags 'phros pas bgegs rnams bsreg /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// dam nyams dgra bo'i gdan steng na// brkyang brkum tshul du bzhugs pa ste// spyan gsum sdang mig glog ltar 'khyugs// rno gdug mche ba bgegs la gtsigs// sku stod glang chen ko rlon gsol// sku smad stag gi sham thabs can// thod rlon 'bar ba'i do shal 'phyang*// yan lag lhu tshigs sbrul gyis brgyan// nag po klu 'dul chen po khyod// ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas// sdom dang sdig pa'i tshwa tshwa 'phro// dam nyams dgra la sprul pa 'gyed// ral pa sprugs pas khams gsum 'gengs// stong gsum 'byung po rdul du rlog /phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po na// gnam lags 'bar ba'i gri gug gis// dgra bgegs 'byung po'i srog rtsa gcod// phyag drug g.yon gyi dang po na// bhandha khrag gis gang ba bsnams// dgra bgegs klad khrag zhal du gsol// phyag drug g.yas kyi bar pa na// thod skam 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'dren// 'gro drug sems can 'dren pa'i rtags// phyag drug g.yon gyi bar pa na// kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum bsnams pa ni// 'bras bu sku gsum brnyas pa'i rtags// phyag drug g.yas kyi tha ma na// ḍā ma ru ni drag tu 'khrol// ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud// ma mo mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// 'dir byon sha khrag gtor ma bzhes// dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las mdzod cig

/phyag drug g.yon gyi tha ma na// bdud zhags nag po bsnams pa ni// bstan pa bshigs pa'i rke la thob// khyod kyi 'khor gyi pho nya'i tshogs// mkha' 'gro ma dang shugs 'gro ma// gnod sbyin pho dang gnod sbyin mo// gnod sbyin kṣe tra pā la'i tshogs// bran gyi tshul du khas blangs pa// dam bca' bzhin du 'dir gshegs shig /'bru bcud chang dang rakta khrag /māṃ sa sha dang rus pa'i tshogs// dam rdzas (599)gtor ma 'di mchis kyis// phrin las bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol// dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal// 'jigs su rung ba bskal pa yi// me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// ma hā kā la mthu bo che// sde brgyad ma mo mkha' 'gros bskor// nag po mi zad bsam las 'das// lha mo dkar nag bgrang du med// snang srid thams cad khyod kyi bran// srid gsum thams cad khyod kyi 'khor// dregs pa can rnams las mkhan te// stong gsum skad cig glog ltar myur// sdang dgra gnod bgegs thal bar rlog /bdag cag dam tshig sgrub pa po// 'das dang bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi// spyan sngar zhal bzhes dran dgongs la// gtor ma ri la rakta mtsho// bdud rtsi rgya mtsho lta bur 'khyil// phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rnams tshang*// dam tshig ldan pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs// hūm̐/ dad pa ni dam tshig sogs sbrel lo// mchod pa 'bul ba shin tu bsdu na/ /mchod yon sogs so sor mi bral bar lha rdzas bzang po'i phyi mchod 'di/ zhes dang*/ sngags kyang ārghaṃ ma sogs chab gcig sbrel na rung*/ 'bring du byed na gzhung ltar dang*// rgyas par byed na de steng lha rdzas bzang po'i gzugs mchog 'di// ru pa zhes dang*/ de bzhin sgra snyan= shabda= dri mchog= gandhe= ro mchog= ra sa= reg bya= zhes 'dod yon lnga mchod kyang 'bul/ yang mchod phreng tshig tshogs rgyas par spro na/ /hūm̐/ bla ma ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas kyi// rdo rje'i dbang po rnam pa thams cad pa// mnyes byed phyi nang gsang mchod rdo rje'i sprin// dngos 'byor yid byung ting 'dzin rol pas mchod// dri med yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon sbreng*// dmar chen khrag gi rba rlabs dgung du 'phyo// yid byed mtshan rtog dwangs ba'i phyag rgya che// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas mdun sar 'bul// oṃ shrī badzra ma hā kā la sa pā ri wa ra badzra arghaṃ pra twitstsha swā hā/

rnyogs med reg 'jam bsil zhing dwangs pa'i chu// gsod byed nag po (600)brtsegs pas sbags pa'i mtsho// nyes pa kun 'khrud dag byed a yi chab// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas zhabs la 'bul/ /sngags thog mtha' sngar ltar la/ badzra pādyaṃ= utpal chu skyes sna tshogs 'dab brgya'i phreng*// dbang po rnam lnga dug gi me tog bkra// 'bar 'dzag bde stong padmo rab bzhad pa// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas dbu la 'bul// puṣpe= /sbyar dang lhan skyes dri bzang zhing kun khyab/ tshil chen dud pa'i sprin phung nam mkhar gang*// chos kun bden med sgyu mar rang shar spos// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas shangs la 'bul// dhū pe= /nyi zla nor bu mar me'i snang ba brdal// zhun chen mar nag yi dwags me yis spar// kun rtog dbu mar thim pa'i 'od gsal ba// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas spyan la 'bul// dī pe= ga bur tsandan gur gum sbyar ba'i chu// khrag chen zhag gi spris chags sgron me lnga// nyid 'khrul lha sku rang shar byugs pa'i mchog /ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas sku la 'bul// gandhe= /ro brgya nus pa stong ldan bza' bca'i rigs// dgra bgegs sha rus khyad par lcags kyu lnga// ma bsgoms 'tshang rgya ye shes zang thal bcud// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas ljags la 'bul// naiwi dya= sil chol dung dang gling bu rnga bo che// dur khrod rdzas chen 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i sgra// lus gsum sbyangs pa'i sku gsum rang shar dbyangs// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas snyan la 'bul// shabda= de tsam mam/ 'dod yon lnga'ang spro na/ snod bcud snang ba thogs bcas thogs med tshogs// yul shes rnam dag gzugs kyi rdo rje ma// rang shar lha sku phyag rgya'i 'du 'phro yis// ye shes mgon po'i spyan mchog tshims gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra ma hā kā la sa pā ri wā ra rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pra tī tstsha swā hā/

zin dang ma zin phyi nang brjod pa'i tshogs// yul shes rnam dag sgra yi rdo rje ma// gzhom med rang byung sngags kyi sgra dbyangs (601)kyis// ye shes mgon po'i snyan mchog tshims gyur cig /shabda= rang byung yongs su sbyar las skyes pa'i ngad// yul shes rnam dag dri yi rdo rje ma// 'od gsal phyag rgya chen por 'khyud pa'i dris// ye shes mgon po'i shangs mchog= gandhe= ro mchog brgya ldan bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs// yul shes rnam dag ro yi rdo rje ma// 'pho med bde chen rtag pa'i sems byed kyis// ye shes mgon po'i ljags mchog= ra sa= /lhab lhub gos dang g.yang gzhi'i na bza'i tshogs// yul shes rnam dag reg bya'i rdo rje ma// dga' ba bcu drug lhan skyes 'khril chags kyis// ye shes mgon po'i sku mchog tshims gyur cig /sparshe= de nas nang mchod cung zad rgyas par spro na/ byin rlabs gong du ma song na 'dir bya/ song na gsar du mi dgos// mtheb srin gyis thigs gtor spyi bo snying kha ste gsang gi thad nas rim par bul bzhin tu/ rdo rje 'chang dang dbang chen padma 'byung*// sha ba ri pa mai tri rā hu la// khyung po rmog lcogs zhang sgom chos seng sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// 'khor lo bde mchog dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus// sgyu 'phrul chen mo dgyes pa rdo rje dang*// rdo rje 'jigs byed ha ya grī wa sogs// yi dam lha tshogs zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /spro na gtso 'khor gyi sngags rnams kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la 'bul/ myur mdzad ma hā kā la re ma ti// bka' sdod gnod sbyin bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu// gtsang ris mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs// dam can rgya mtsho'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// gnas gsum dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*// dkar phyogs skyong ba gnas dang gzhi yi bdag /skye bzhi lam rgyud lngas bsdus 'gro ba rnams// ye shes lhar gsal zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

/zhes 'bul la 'bru gsum brjod cing lhag ma rang gis myong ngo*// de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gnad gsum kyi thog mar bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi skabs su/ bdag dang sems can thams cad mgrin gcig tu gsol ba 'debs par mos la/

na mo buddhā ya 'i (602) sngags bdun sogs kyis gsol ba btab pa'i rjes su/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la// bdag gis phyi me tog bdug spos/ nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang ba bde stong gi ye shes/ yang gsang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dam pa rnams 'bul lo/ /zhes dang dmigs pa chos drug dkyus ltar byas pa'i rjes su/ bdag gi lus la sku'i byin rlabs 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ bdag gi lus la sku'i byin rlabs ma zhugs pa zhugs par gsol/ bdag gi lus la sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par gyur to// bdag gi ngag la gsung gi byin rlabs sogs dang*/ bdag gi yid la thugs kyi byin rlabs sogs dang*/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhes 'don pa spos te gong gi rigs 'gres sbyar/ sku'i skabs su bla ma'i dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po dang mgon po'i dpral ba las mgon po sku chung la yan lag rags pa ḍā ma ru dang dril bu'i sgra sil sil khrol khrol hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pa dpag med byon te rang gi dpral bar thim/ lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgon po'i sku dang dbyer med du gyur/ des 'gres te/ gsung las 'od zer dang sku dmar po byon/ rang gi mgrin par thim/ ngag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ mgon po'i gsung dang dbyer med du gyur/ thugs las 'od zer dang sku mthing kha byon/ rang gi snying khar thim/ yid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /sher dbang thob/ mgon po'i thugs dang dbyer med du gyur/ gnas gsum ka nas 'od zer dang sku sna tshogs pa byung*/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ sgo gsum cha snyom gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ mgon po'i ye shes rdo rje dang dbyer med du gyur par mos la/ /kyai/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sogs kyis gsol ba btab gdung shugs bskyed pas mgon po'i zhal nas khyed kyi bar chad thams cad ngas sel/

mthun rkyen thams cad ngas sgrub bo zhes gsung lhang lhang bzhugs par mos/ slar mgon po'i sku lus thams cad las 'od zer dmar nag mang po chad pa dang*/ sngar gyi 'od zer dang mgon po de rnams rang gi sgo gsum dang dbyer med du 'dres/ lus sems thams cad bde bas gang bar bsam la bde stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i rang ngo la (603) mnyam par bzhag /yang lus kyi nang na mgon po de rnams gar mdzad cing nad gdon thams cad dmar chir chir zhal du gsol bar bsgom la 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /ces pa'i skabs su rol mo'i sgra drag po bya/ de nas gsol 'debs tshigs bcad ma ci 'grub brjod cing*/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi sgrub pa byed na skabs 'dir/ oṃ gu ru ma hā kā la siddhi hūm̐/ zhes bzlas bya'i snying po ste 'di'i bka' thob na skong gso'i skabs su'ang bzlas pa brgya rtsa tsam byed pa legs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur zhing 'di'i dmigs pa ni gong gsal de nyid bskyar ba kho na'o// gzhung rkyang las sab kha 'di mi byed pa'i skabs su'ang dmigs pa ni gsol 'debs kyi skabs su 'gro dgos so// gnad gnyis pa grib sel gyi skabs su rgyas pa dang*/ bsdus pa gnyis yod/ rgyas pa ni grib sel sger du sgrub pa sogs de nyid gtso bor ston pa'i skabs su bya rgyu yin te/ de'ang bla ma rdor sems bskyed chog grub pa'i skabs/ steng gi nam mkha' la rtsa ba gsum dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sku rdo rje rnam snang dkar po gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med dmar po thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa sngon po'i rnam par byon te steng 'og rim pa gsum sprin gtibs pa ltar 'khod par mos la mos gus bskyed de/ sku rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bla ma'i sku la grib kyis phog pa dang sku'i dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sku rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams las yi ge brgya pa dkar po'i tshogs 'phros/ bla ma'i dpral bar phog pas bla ma'i sku la grib kyis phog pa dang sku'i dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur/ zhes mos la yig brgya bzla/ de bzhin tu gsung dang thugs la sbyar te so sor yig brgya bzla/ de nas bla ma rin po che mgon po'i sku la grib kyis phog pa dang sku'i dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i dpral ba nas yi ge brgya ba dkar po'i tshogs 'phros/ mgon po'i dpral bar thim pas sogs yig brgya dang*/ gsung thugs kha bsgyur gong gis rigs 'gre/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med/ 'khor rnams kyi sku la sogs gsol ba gdab/ (604)bla ma dang mgon po gnyis ka'i dpral bar nas yi ge brgya pa dkar po'i tshogs sogs/ gsung thugs yig brgya bcas gong bzhin/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma mgon po dbyer med 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi gnas gsum nas yi ge brgya pa dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ bdag sogs kyi gnas gsum du thim pas lus ngag yid gsum la grib kyis phog pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur/ /zhes mos la yig brgya bzla// phyi ma 'di'i skabs su yig rnying nas bla mgon dbyer med kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar dbang bzhi'i dmigs pa dang sgrags te dmigs bzlas so sor phye ba'ang bshad pas nus na de ltar yang bya'o// bsdus pa ni dgu gtor sogs kyi dkyus la sbyar bar bya zhing*// de'ang gong ma nyid cung zad bsdu ba yin te/ rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la grib kyis phog pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi gnas gsum nas yi ge brgya ba dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi tshogs 'phros/ bla ma'i gnas gsum du thim pas sku gsung thugs la grib kyis phog pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur/ yig brgya bdun/ des 'gre ste/ bla ma rin po che/ mgon po'i sku gsung thugs la sogs dang*/ bla ma'i gnas gsum nas yi ge brgya pa sogs kyi mthar yig brgya bdun/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med/ 'khor rnams dang bdag gi sgo gsum la grib kyis phog pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma mgon po'i gnas gsum nas yi ge brgya pa dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi tshogs 'phros/ 'khor rnams dang bdag gi gnas gsum du thim pas/ (605)'khor rnams kyi sku gsung thugs la grib kyis phog pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshigs nyams chags thams cad dag// bdag gi lus kyi nang yi ge brgya pa'i 'od zer gyis gang bas sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par gyur/ zhes mos la yig brgya bdun bzla'o/ cho ga dkyus ltar la 'di'i sab kha mi byed pa'i tshe na'ang yig brgya nyer gcig la dmigs gnad 'di bzhin so so sbyar dgos so// de nas gdung shugs drag po dang ldan pas bshags pa byas la/ skong rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bhrūṃ las gnas khang dur khrod drag po'i bkod pa 'jigs su rung ba dang ldan pa'i dbus su/ hūm̐ yig nag po dpag tu med pa las byung ba'i/ phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rdzas sgrub rdzas mchod rdzas skong rdzas la sogs pa dgyes shing mthun pa'i rdzas ma tshang ba med cing phun sum tshogs pa/ ngo bo ye shes kyi rang bzhin/ rnam pa ye shes mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa dgyes pa skong ba'i byed las dang ldan pa'i dam tshig gi mchod sprin tshad med pas nam mkha'i khams rgyas par gang bar gyur/

na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ uṅga te spha ra ṇa i ma ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ /lan gsum/ oṃ badzra spa ra ṇa khaṃ// hūm̐/ spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rjes khros pa'i gar// myur mdzad ye shes mgon po 'khor dang bcas// thugs dam bskang phyir dad pas spyan 'dren na// dam tshig dbang gis 'dir gshegs brtan par bzhugs// mchog gsum rtsa gsum sngags rgya ting nge 'dzin// chos nyid rten 'brel bslu med bden pa yis// mchod pa'i dam rdzas zhing khams kun khyab pas// mgon po 'khor bcas dgyes pa skong gyur cig /mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang*// snang gsal dri mchog zhal zas rol mo'i sgra// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan lhab lhub kyis// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla rgyal srid bdun// bkra shis rdzas rtags (606)brgyad dang dpag bsam shing*// yid bzhin nor sogs srid gsum dpal 'byor gyis// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// 'ja' 'od me tog char dang nor bu'i sprin// rin chen ri bo ma rmos lo tog 'bru// khrus rdzing skyed tshal 'dod 'jo'i ba mo yis// ye shes mgon po= /sna tshogs gzugs dang sna tshogs sgra dbyangs dang*// sna tshogs dri dang sbyar ba'i bde bskyed chab// bcud ldan bza' btung reg 'jam gos mchog gis// ye shes mgon po= /'jigs rung dur khrod drag po'i pho brang bkod// g.yang gzhi'i bla bre rgyu rlon lda ldi 'phyang*// zhing chen rgyal mtshan ro skra'i rnga yab kyis// ye shes mgon po= /snying khrag arghaṃ dug chu'i zhabs bsil dang*// dbang po'i me tog bam chen bsregs pa'i gsur// zhun chen snang gsal khrag mkhris zhag gi chab// ye shes mgon po= /sha rus don snying ba liṃ ri ltar spungs// 'bru bcud dang sbyar bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bskyil// bsad khrag rba rlabs dgung du 'chel ba yis// ye shes mgon po=

/thod rnga rkang gling rnga rol snyan brjid dbyangs// gu gul sha chen dug yungs bsregs pa'i spos// dar nag ba dan mi lpags g.yab mo yis// ye shes mgon po= /bya nag rta nag drel nag dom nag dang*// g.yag nag lug nag khyi nag bcu gsum sogs// sna tshogs rgyan spras phyi yi rten rnams kyis// ye shes mgon po= /me long dar nag sngags byang btags pa'i mda'// bya rgod sgro dang gri lcags mde 'us spras// nal bu'i rgyal mtshan la sogs nang rten gyis// ye shes mgon po= /srog sngags sman 'bru rin chen dar zab kyis// legs par bkang ba'i gri rgod tsitta dang*// nal bu dom nag snying sogs gsang rten gyis// ye shes mgon po= /mkha' spyod dga' ma'i chos 'khor thabs shes kyi// bha gar rang sems bla ma dbyer med pa// snang stong sku la mi phyed gdung shugs kyis// ye shes mgon po= /bskyed rim lha bsgom bris 'bur sku yi rten// rlung (607)sngags bzlas pa srog 'khor gsung gi rten// phyag rgya ting 'dzin phyag mtshan thugs kyi rten// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// bhandha zhā nag ber phod yon tan rten// zhi rgyas dbang drag las sbyor phrin las rten// drag po'i ru mtshon chas zhugs gar 'chams kyis// ye shes mgon po= /glang ko stag lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi dang*// thod phreng do shal phyag rgya rnam pa drug /sprul chun sindhu ra yi byugs pa yis// ye shes mgon po= /go mtshon sna tshogs rgyan gyi bye brag dang*// spyan gzigs dkor cha bsam gyis mi khyab pa// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul pa yis// ye shes mgon po= /bla med byang chub bsnyen cing sgrub pa dang*// las bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor srung bzlog drag shul gyi// mngon spyod rig sngags dmod pa'i sbyor ba yis// ye shes mgon po= /bcu drug rig ma'i dga' bzhi'i rol rtsed dang*// dug gsum khams gsum rtsad nas bcad pa yi// sbyor sgrol ga ṇa tsakra'i gsang pa yis// ye shes mgon po=

/'bar 'dzag bde chen 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i ngang*// spros bral 'od gsal rang shar lha yi sku// mchog gi phyag chen thun mong grub brgyad kyis// ye shes mgon po= /rten sgrub mchod skong khyad par dam tshig dang*// srid zhi'i dpal 'byor bde ba'i yo byad ni// chos dbyings nam mkha'i mthar thugs yongs su gang*// yid ches mos gus rtse gcig gdung shugs kyis// myur mdzad ye shes mgon po'i thugs dam bskang*// mgon po yid bzhin nor bu'i thugs dam bskang*// blo 'phel dbang gi rgyal po'i= /tshe bdag sna tshogs mkha' 'gro'i= /ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo'i= /gnod sbyin kṣe tra pā la'i= /dbang phyug dzi na mi tra'i= /gshen rje ṭā ki rā dza'i= /bdud mgon trakshad nag po'i= /gtsang ris dpal mgon bdun cu'i= /bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i= /sprul pa yang sprul tshogs kyi= /pho nya las byed rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam gnyen po dbyings su (608)bskangs nas kyang*// sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi// chags nyams 'gal 'khrul byang zhing sor chud nas// las dang dngos grub thogs pa med par stsol// chos 'khor dben gnas rnal 'byor 'khor bcas skyongs// phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen thams cad sol// byang chub sgrub la bar du gcod pa zlog /'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs pa kun las skyobs// mi nor zas gsum bshad sgrub 'du ba spel// rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par sgrub brgyud kyi// bstan pa yar ngo'i zla bzhin rgyas mdzad gsol// thugs bskyed thugs dam gnyan po ma bsnyel bar// mos pa'i bu la rtag tu thugs rjes gzigs// lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab pa dang*// 'dod pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /yang tshar grangs gsog bder lta bur de las bsdus par 'dod na chags med rin po ches mdzad pa 'di ltar bya ste/ /hūm̐/ myur mdzad mgon po 'khor bcas kyi// thugs dam gnyan po bdag gis bskang*// nyams chags bskang la zhig ral gso// gnong 'gyod sems mkhon thams cad sbyang*// gnam lcags rwa dang glog gi lce// sprin nag 'khrugs 'dra'i spu zhol can// g.yag lug dar snas brgyan pa 'dis// mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// smyug ldems bya rgod sgro yis brgyan// gnam lcags ngar ma'i mdel gyis mthud// dar nag cod pan g.yo ba 'dis// mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo yi// don snying lag gis dmar 'byin byas// rin chen 'bru sman snying pos bkang*// mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma dang*// dbyer med myur mdzad mgon po la// yid ches drag po'i nges shes 'dis// mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// dmar chen gtor ma ri ltar spungs// chang dang rakta mtsho ltar bskyil// dngos 'byor yid sprul dpag med 'dis// mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// khyed kyi thugs dam ngas bskang (609)gis/

bcol ba'i las rnams khyod kyis sgrubs// bsten pa'i tshe na rgyang ma ring*// 'bod pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra// sgrub pa'i tshe na gong ma g.yel// g.yab pa'i tshe na spyan ma rdul// mngags pa'i tshe na bang ma bul// jo bor bsten no dbang ma che// grogs por bsten na gzhung ma ngan// shag ltar bsten na khrel ma chung*// ma ltar bsten na snying ma sra// sring ltar bsten na zhe ma dan// bran ltar bsten na snying ma ring*// sngar byas las kyi btang rag gtong*// da lta las kyi gnyer zas 'dren// phyi byed las kyi zhu skyem 'bul// thugs dam gnyan po skong gyur cig /bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/

/de nas bshags pa ni/ /hūm̐/ mgon po 'khor bcas spyan snga ru// bdag gis bag med dbang gyur bas// rten rdzas ma tshang mchod tshogs chung*// bskyed rim ma gsal sngags ma dag /rjen 'thag spos sbyor ma 'dzom dang*// bya khyi nag por 'tshe ba sogs// nyes pa gang mchis thams cad bshags// mi bsgribs tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /'di'i lugs su man ngag gi yig brgya'ang bzla bar gsungs/ sangs rgyas gnyan ston gyis mdzad par grags pa'i skong ba de ni gnyan ston gyi gsung du mi snang la grong sngags pa mi mkhas pa rnying ma'i tshig rna bar thos bzhig gi las su dogs/ mkhas grub rje'i gtor chog tu bkod pa 'di'ang rje yab sras gang rung gi gsung las shangs lugs kyi yig rnying ni ma yin cing tshig tshogs cung mang bas 'dir khyer bder byas pa'o// de dag gong gi mthar yang dmigs bsal dgos pa dang 'brel na bstod bskul zlog pa dang 'brel ba 'di'ang bya ste/ /hūm̐/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug mgon po ni// gnas la nges pa ma mchis kyang*// sems can so so'i snang ngo la// rdo rje gdan gyi lho phyogs ngos// dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal// 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas mchog na// gshin rje'i ngar skad di ri ri// ma mo'i bshugs glu kyu ru ru// rakta'i rgya mtsho chi li li// tshil chen zhun mar lhabs se lhab// gsur chen dud pa chi li li// pho (610)bdud bro brdung chems se chem// mo bdud shon skor sgo ro ro// mi rkang gling bu kyu ru ru// gcan gzan ngar skad 'u ru ru// glog chen 'bar ba khyugs se khyug /'brug sgra drag po chems se chem// gnam lcags ser chen sha ra ra// bdud dang srin po'i tshogs rnams kyi// 'jigs pa'i gad mos sa gzhig yo// de lta'i gnas mchog dam pa na// zhal gcig phyag drug 'jigs pa'i sku// zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rkan rdeb cing*// spyan gsum dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar// rngams shing brjid la yan lag rags// drag po'i hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog

/lhun po ltar brjid mig sman mdog /kshiṃ kshiṃ 'jigs pa'i bzhad sgra can// gri gug thod phreng cang te'u 'khrol// thod khrag rtse gsum zhags pa 'dzin// gar mdzad dril bu'i sgra sgrog pa// yum gcig ma mo kun gyi bdag /srog gcod shan pa gnod sbyin bzhi// phyogs skyong dpal mgon bdun cu'i tshogs// dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas// 'dir spyon mthun pa'i das rdzas bzhes// hūm̐/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mtshan btags pa// mthu chen log 'dren rnams kyi gshed// phyag na rdo rjes mtshan btags pa// nag po klu 'dul chen po ste// gshin rje'i gshed pos mtshan btags pa// rdo rje ro langs dur khrod bdag /gsang ba'i mtshan nas 'bod kyis spyon// bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra// g.yabs pa'i tshe na spyan ma brtul// bskul ba'i tshe na bang ma bul// rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung*// bskang ba'i tshe na thugs ma g.yel// gsol btab tshe na snying ma ring*// gtsang zhing tshang la ma nyams pa// dgyes pa'i dam rdzas rgya mtsho 'dis// do nub 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// nyams chags ci mchis bshags par bgyi// sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gtong*// da 'chol las kyi rten du 'bul// bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// hūm̐/ khyed la zhu zhing gsol ba ni// bla ma dam (611)pa'i sku yi dgra// bstan bshig dam nyams dgra bo dang*// bdud kyi rigs gyur nag po'i phyogs// bar du gcod pa'i bgegs rnams kyis// dkyil 'khor gnyen po dral ba ste// thub pa'i bstan pa bshig pa ste// rnal 'byor bshad sgrub gegs byed cing*// chos 'khor gnyan po bshig pa ste// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas// mi nor dge 'dun bcas pa rnams// bcol lo ltos so mthu ma chung*// nyin gsum bya ra ma g.yel zhig /mtshan gsum mel tshe ma g.yel zhig /'gal rkyen zlog la mthun rkyen sgrubs// hūm̐/ dam nyams dgra dang bgegs rnams kyi// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul nyams par gyis// rgyab brten lha dang myur du khrol// mdza' bo kun dang rnam par phyes// khong nas snying byung srog rtsa chod// rigs brgyud rtsad nas chod la shog

/nyes can ltos la shor ra re// rtags phyungs mtshan ma myur du ston// gdug cing sdang ba'i dgra bo 'dis// bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra byas// rdo rje'i theg pa sun 'byin cing*// dge 'dun sde rnams dkrug cing 'joms// sdom brtson kun la brnyas shing smod// skye bo yongs la gnod cing 'tshe// rnal 'byor lha med zer nas brnyas// lta khyod mthu med zer nas smod// bstan pa'i dgra bor gyur pa 'di// lo dang zla bar ma bzhag par// ya ma rā dza'i zhal du thob// gshog pa can gyis mtha' nas chums// sder mo can gyis snying nas drongs// mche ba can gyis klad nas phug /las kyi rlung gis rgyab nas ded// mun pa nag pos mdun nas bsus// ṭā kki rā dzas g.yas nas chums/ tshogs bdag glang snas g.yon nas chums// gnam gyi 'ju thag chod la shog /sa yi lte phur thon la shog /don snying lnga po phyung la shog /kha nas khong khrag skyug tu chug /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi thong*// bdud kyi sgo bro brdung du chug /btsan gyi zhags pa 'debs su chug /ma mo'i dal yams dgra la (612)thong*// bstan pa'i dgra bor gyur pa 'di// khram la babs kyis khram la thob// sho la bab kyi sho phye zhig /dam nyams las ngan sdig can 'di// lo dang zla bar ma bzhag par// rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ston// bcol pa'i las 'di ma byas na// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' yang bcag /phyi rabs sngags 'chang sun yang phyung*// rig 'dzin bdag gi re ba bcad// sngon gyi thugs dam gnyan po nyams// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig 'gal// thub pa'i bstan srung ming tsam gyur// de bas dam la ma 'da' bar// mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /ces pas bskul/ /chos sku yangs pa'i pho brang nas// lha chen mgon po 'khor bcas kyis// mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas la// gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa dang*// 'tshe zor yungs zor 'phen pa zlog

/'byung pos thod zor 'phen pa zlog /gshin rjes 'khor los bskor ba zlog /bdud kyis khram kha bstan pa= /ma mos khrag zor= /zhang zhung dzo dmar= /sum pas glang zor= /bandes sngags zor= /bon pos brda zor= /sngags pas kong zor= /skyes pas mda' zor= /bud med dmod zor= /mu stegs bar chad byed pa= /ngan sngags gdug pa'i rbod gtong= /klu yis byad du bcug pa= /the'u rang sris la rku ba= /rgyal pos smyo 'bog gtong ba= /drang srong gza' yi king kang= /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi= /ye 'drogs sum brgya drug cu= /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// lo kegs zla kegs zhag kags dang*// nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog /mkha' 'gro ma dang ro langs dang*// rgyal bsen bar chad byed pa zlog /de la sogs pa'i gdug sems rnams// thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo// thams cad gnod pa'i bgegs la bhyo/ /zhes so// de nas gnad gsum pa mkha' 'gro dbang sdud ni gzhung gsal ltar la// gnad dbab ni rgyun tu mi bya zhing (613) dgos pa byung na 'di dang gong gi gnad gnyis po'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa rnams kyang gud du shes par bya'o// snying po'i bzlas dmigs gzhung gsal ltar la/ rtsa sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer me 'od lta bu 'phros te mgon po'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la phog pas/ mgon po khros 'khrugs rngams pas zhabs sa la rdebs cing zhal nas hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrog /ḍā ma ru drag tu 'khrol zhing 'khor rnams la spyan hrig hrig gzigs pas/ 'khor rnams rang dbang med par khros 'khrugs te rang rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa 'khor dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur song bas bdag cag dpon slob sogs kyi chos sgrub pa'i bar du gcod pa thams cad tshar bcad par bsam la shā sa na bzla/ 'khor rnams rang rang gi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon bsgom/

bdag nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer dmar po 'phros te/ de dag la phog pas/ de dang de'i thugs rgyud bskul bar bsams la so so'i sngags bzla/ bzlas pa grub nas gtor ma 'bul ba'i thog mar sngar byin rlabs ma zin na chang dang*/ chu dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa'i nang mchod kyis rim par bran nas byin rlabs byas la/ na mo/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa ma g.yel zhig /ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti ma= /gnod sbyin kṣe tra pā la ma= /dbang phyug dzi na mi tra ma= /gshin rje ṭā kki rā dza ma= /bdud mgon trakshad nag po ma= /gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga ma= /bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho ma= /bsgrubs bsgrubs bsten bsten pa rnams ma= /slob dpon brgyud pa'i srung ma= /bar chad bsrung ba'i dus la bab kyis ma= /dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab kyis ma= /dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab kyis ma g.yel zhig /mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags sogs gzhung ltar la dmigs pa dang bcas pas hūm̐ ring po drug brjod la so so'i gtor sngags kyis 'bul/ arghaṃ sogs dang*/ /so so'i sngags la oṃ āḥhūm̐ (614) btags pas nang mchod phul/ /gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgyan dam pa dang ldan pa/ dri dam pa dang ldan pa/ ro dam pa dang ldan pa/ reg bya dam pa dang ldan pa 'di nyid 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni// dpal ma hā kā la/ mgon po legs ldan nag po/ bdud gcod kyi skyes bu/ bdud 'dul gyi dmag dpon/ srin po laṅka bu ri'i grong khyer sum brtsegs brlag par byed pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/ rig 'dzin gyi srung ma/ bla ma'i bka' srung*/ bstan pa'i bya ra mkhan/ legs nyes kyi stangs 'dzin/ khro bo'i gzugs can/ za byed kyi sha gdong can/ ye shes kyi spyan ldan/ sha zan gyi gtso bo/ khrag 'thung gi rgyal po/

dam nyams kyi srog gcod/ mna' zan gyi gshed ma/ nag po 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor pa/ sha za bye ba'i 'khor gyis bskor ba/ g.yas nas pho rgyud stong gi 'khor gyis bskor ba/ g.yon nas mo rgyud stong gi 'khor gyis bskor ba/ bka' sdod lha mo nag mo 'khor dang bcas pa/ gnod sbyin kṣe tra pā la= /dbang phyug dzi na mi tra= /gshin rje ṭā kki rā dza= /bdud mgon trakshad nag po/ gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga= /bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis dam rdzas rgyan dang ldan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs shig /dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang stod cig /dge 'dun gyi chos 'khor skyongs shig /chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs shig /khyad par du rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la bar du gcod pa'i dgra gdon bgegs tshogs thams cad myur du zhi zhing mi 'byung ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod snyan grags mnga' thang chos brgyud nyams rtogs la sogs pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ 'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs pa thams cad las skyobs cing mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur du stsol cig /ces phrin las bcol/ yang gtor chen sogs kyi skabs su/ (615)dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku la bsdo ba/ rdo rje theg pa'i gsang ba sun 'byin pa/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bor gyur pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs smod pa/ dge 'dun gyi chos 'khor bshig pa/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ sbyor ba phyin ci log byed pa'i 'byung po las ngan sdig can mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyi bsam pa ngan pa dang sbyor ba rtsub pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod cig

/gal te de dag zhi bas 'dul du ma 'tshal ba lta na/ bsad pa dang*/ gzir ba dang*/ bskrad pa dang*/ rengs pa dang*/ rmugs shing lkugs pa dang*/ bsdigs shing sba bkong ba la sogs pa drag po'i las kyis tshar bcad de thal ba rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod cig /bla ma mgon po 'khor bcas la/ bdag gis mchod gtor phul ba yis/ dkon mchog dbu 'phangs smod pa dang*/ theg pa chen po sun 'byin dang*/ bstan pa 'jig dang dbyen byed dang*// bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang*/ rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba rnams/ de dag nag po chen pos sgrol// a mu ka mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces thal mo brdab bo// de nas gzhung gi bstod pa myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs kyi 'phros su rgyas par bya ba'am/ res mos lta bu spro na/ oṃ 'grub par gyur cig /dur khrod chen po 'jigs su rung ba'i nang*// tshang tshing 'khrigs pa tsandan chen po'i tshal// bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// bgegs chen bsnol ba'i gdan la rab tu bzhengs// ma hā kā la phyag drug brjid pa'i sku// sku yi cha lugs mi bzad 'bar ba la// dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa po// gsung gi nga ro mi bzad 'bar ba la// hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra yis stong gsum 'gengs// rnam dag thugs ni mi bzad 'bar ba la// spros dang bral yang mtshan ma cir yang ston// (616)sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas khyod la bstod// phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po'i gri gug ni// nyon mongs rtsad nas gcod cing dgra la 'phyar// phreng ba 'dzin pas skye 'gro rtsis la 'debs// ḍā ma ru yis mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud// 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtso la phyag 'tshal lo// g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag bsnams pa yis// dgra bgegs klad khrag zhal du gsol bar mdzad// mdung rtse gsum pas khams gsum dbang du sdud// zhags pas dam nyams ma lus 'ching bar byed// byin rlabs dngos grub ster la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi sku la 'gyur ba med rtags su// sku mdog mthing nag rab tu 'bar ba la// khrag 'dzag lnga bcu rtsa lngas brgyan pa bo// stag gi pags pa sbrul gyi chun pos mdzes// ma hā kā la khyod la bdag bstod do// bi nā ya ka bsnol ba'i gdan steng na// krig krig zhabs kyis bgegs chen thal bar rlog

/zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs shing rngams pa yis// dam nyams khong khrag 'dren cing zhal du gsol// mthu chen bgegs kyi gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// spyan gsum me ltar 'bar zhing bgrad pa yin// khams gsum dbang du sdud cing rtsis la 'debs// dbu skra 'bar ba brdzes pa'i spyi bo na// mi bskyod rgyal pos rab tu brgyan pa po// dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐/ bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs// bskul lo bskul lo 'gro ba'i don la bskul// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod// ma g.yel ma g.yel dpal ldan nag po che// skyobs pa shākya seng ge'i spyan snga ru// bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i// las 'di rnams kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// skyes bu dam pa blo dang ldan pa yis// bstod pa 'di yis lan cig bstod byed na// pha ma bu tsha rnams la brtse ba bzhin// nag po chen pos rtag tu grogs mdzod cig

/nag po chen po la bstod pa rngams pa'i sgra sgrogs zhes bya ba slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'o// (617)bhyo/ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// rlung nag 'tshubs mar 'tshubs pa'i pho brang na// ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug re ma tī// sku mdog nag mo char sprin lta bu la// thod skam dbu brgyan snyan g.yas seng ge 'phyo// g.yon pa sbrul 'khyil sbrul gyi gdengs ka can// spyan gsum dmar 'khrugs zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs// 'jigs byed lha mo khyed la bdag bstod do// g.yas pa ral gri 'bar bas dgra srog gcod// g.yon pa thod rlon dgra bgegs snying khrag gsol// sku stod zhing lpags sbrul nag ska rags bcings// sku smad glang chen ko rlon re ldes dkris// stong gsum bgrod phyir dre'u rta rkang gsum chibs// srin po'i ya mgal snga ru khram bam btags// gong smed sbrul nag nad rkyal dgra la 'phyo// mchod gtor 'di bzhes dgra bgegs sgrol la shog /bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod// bhyo/ bskal ba'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// rlung nag 'tshubs mar 'tshubs pa'i pho brang na// rta khrag mi khrag rgya mtsho'i rba klong 'khrugs// dam nyams dgra bo bsnol ba'i gdan steng na// ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug re ma ti// sku mdog mthing nag char sprin lta bu la// dbu skra khams ser rma bya'i mdongs kyis brgyan// byang chub sems ldan spyi gtsug zla rgyas gsal// thod pas dbu brgyan snyan g.yas seng ge 'phyo// snyan g.yon dril 'khrol sbrul nag gdengs ka can// spyan gsum dmar 'khrugs glog ltar 'khyug byed cing*// zhal nas 'jigs pa'i 'brug sgra chems chems sgrog /dpral ba'i dkyil nas gnam lcags thog ser 'bebs// shangs nas nad kyi rlung nag sprin ltar 'tshubs// 'jigs pa'i zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags 'dril zhing*// a la la yi gad rgyangs 'brug ltar sgrog

/stong gsum 'byung po'i tshogs rnams g.yo bar byed// 'jigs byed lha mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag g.yas ral gri gri gug dgra (618)srog gcod// g.yon pas rgyal mtshan thod rlon snying khrag gsol// sku stod zhing lpags sbrul nag ska rags can// sku smad glang chen ko rlon re ldes dkris// stong gsum bgrod phyir dre'u rta rkang gsum chibs// srin po'i ya mgal snga ru khram bam btags// dgra bgegs thams cad khram la 'debs par byed// nad ngan sna tshogs rkyal ba phyi shar btags// dam nyams dgra bo gtan nas brlag par byed// sbrul nag stong gi chun pos gong smed byas// bstan pa srung mdzad bdud mo 'bum gyis bskor// srog bdud chen mos dgra bgegs sgrol la shog /mi tri pas zhal gzigs dus bstod pa'o/ /bhyo/ rnam dag dbyings la rang byung dpal 'bar ma// bdud rnams skrag mdzad rab 'jigs gzugs can ma// dur khrod chas kyis sku la rab brgyan ma// tshad med phyag bzhis thod khrag mtshon 'dzin ma// thugs rje myur mdzad dre'u chibs mdzad ma// bstan pa srung zhing rnal 'byor skyong mdzad ma// las rnams sgrub cing bstan dgra tshar gcod ma// bstod cing gsol 'debs bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /bla ma rā hu las rgyud 'bum nas byung ba'o/ /bhyo/ dka' ba dang du blangs nas khyod bsgrubs na// ma g.yel ma g.yel ma gcig re ma ti// lus srog 'ban du bcugs nas khyod bsgrubs na// bsten pa'i tshe na ma gcig snying ma ring*// rakta mtsho ltar bskyil nas khyod bsgrubs na// bskul ba'i tshe na ma gcig bang ma bul// gtor ma ri ltar spungs nas khyod bsgrubs na// rbad ba'i tshe na ma gcig mthu ma chung*/ khyed kyi g.yog ni mi srun gdug pa can// chu srin gdong can dgra bgegs sgrol la shog /slad kyi rjes 'brang seng ge'i gdong pa can// dam nyams dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod la shog

/ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas kyis// sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad zlog pa dang*// mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /mai tri bas mdzad pa'o// de nas 'khor gyi bstod pa (619) gzhung ltar ram/ cung zad rgyas par spro na/ /hūm̐/ mgon po'i bka' nyan phyogs bzhi'i las byad pa// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul drag rtsal bsam mi khyab// srid gsum dregs pa yongs kyi sde dpon te// bka' sdod chen po 'khor dang bcas la bstod// gnod sbyin kṣe tra pā la mun pa'i mdog /gri gug phyar zhing thod khrag gtso la stobs// dom nag smyon pa chibs nas stong gsum bskor// drag gtum bzod par dka' ba khyod la bstod// dbang phyug dzi na mi tra me ltar 'bar// zhal nas dug thun khrag gi ser ba 'bebs// cang te'u 'khrol zhing 'khor lo'i mtshon cha 'phen// 'jigs byed srin po'i gzugs can khyod la bstod// gshin rje ṭā ki rā dza rgyu zhags bsdogs// ha la'i mdog can sdigs mdzub bgegs la rngams// bltas pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs srog snying 'phrog /mi bzad gdug pa kun 'dul khyod la bstod// bdud mgon trakshad dus kyi mun pa'i mdangs// rtse gsum snun cing thod snying zhal du gsol// ber nag chas ldan rta nag rting kar chibs// khro rngams sa gsum g.yo ba khyod la bstod// gnod sbyin lha dang gshin rje bdud kyi dmag /ma rungs 'jigs gzugs mtshon cha'i char pa 'bebs// dam ldan skyong zhing dam tshig nyams pa'i gshed// rang rang ris mthun 'bum gyis bskor la bstod// dpal ldan mgon po'i phyi 'khor las byed gtso// tshangs pa 'khor lo thogs shing ngang pa zhon// brgya byin glang chen steng gnas rdo rje bsnams// me lha ra zhon bgrang phreng ril ba 'chang*// gshin rje ma he chibs shing zhing dbyug thogs// srin po ral gri phyir zhing ro langs zhon// chu lha chu srin steng du sbrul zhags bsdogs// rlung lha sha ba la zhon ba dan phyar// gnod sbyin rta zhon rin chen ne'u le btsir// dbang ldan rtse gsum thogs shing glang la gnas// sa bdag phag zhon gser gyi bum pa 'dzin// rang 'dra'i 'khor g.yog 'bum dang bcas la bstod// lha klu gza' dang rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad// (620)rgyal chen sde bzhi 'jigs byed chen po dgu// srid gsum 'byung po dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// bstan pa srung zhing sgrub mchog skyong la bstod// mchod bstod gtor ma phul ba dgyes bzhes la// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe sring ba dang*// rnal 'byor nyams rtogs ye shes 'phel bar mdzod// bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs// thams cad drag po'i las kyis tshar chod la// 'khor dang longs spyod bshad sgrub mthun pa'i rkyen// thams cad yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel bar mdzod/

khro bo gshin rje gshed rdo rje 'jigs byed nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa ma he dang gshin rje pho mo brdzis pa gcig tu gyur te sku de nyid je cher song ba dang*// mgon po yang sku je che bkrag dang gzi mdangs phun sum tshogs par gyur te mdun gyi nam mkha' gang ba tsam dang*/ stong gsum mi mjed kyi zhing 'di gang ba tsam blos 'khyud tshad du bsgom zhing*/ mgon po'i 'od zer 'khor rnams la phog pas so so nas bkrag dang gzi mdangs phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsam zhing*/ stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na ye shes kyi mgon po 'di bas nus mthu che ba med ang snyam du bsam/ 'di ni gtso bor mgon po bdag bskyed la bsgom rgyu yin kyang*/ mdun bskyed la'ang kha spo ba gong ma rnams kyis bzhed cing*/ spyir dpral ba'i sindhū ra la brten nas mkha' 'gro dbang du sdus pa spyi bo'i mi bskyod rgyal po la brten nas rgyud 'jam du btang ba/ gshin rje gshed la brten nas gzi mdangs bskyed pa gsum po ni mgon po 'di sgrub phyin ma shes thabs med pa yin no// de nas rjes kyi las rim rnams ni gzhung nyid du gsal zhing tshang bar yod do/ phrin las kyi kha skong dkyus gcig tu bsdebs pa 'di ni gtso bor gtor sgrub dang*/ dus kyi mchod pa rgyas pa la nye bar mkho zhing de dag gi dmigs ba'i gnad phal mo che'ang gsal bar bkod pas nongs pa mchis na bla ma mgon po thugs rje'i dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa la snying nas bzod par gsol na tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal ba dang yig cha 'di dag gi'ang bka'i gnyer mdzad du gsol/ gsang sgrub dang bla mgon dbyer med snying zhugs gtso bo 'gyur ba'i thabs spyi dang bye brag gi gnad gdams thun mong ma yin pa rnams ni de dag so sor ltos pa las 'di dag gis gcig dpe kun 'gebs 'ong ba ma yin la/ gtor sgrub dang gtor chen gyi gnan
